required_contract: Require one valid bucket and bind it into the exact signed cors target.
Require and encode one caller-bounded exact CORS document.
Generate the exact payload MD5 when omitted or validate and sign one exact 16-byte base64 override.
Preserve omission or sign one exact modeled algorithm and matching payload digest header.
Preserve omission or sign one bounded nonempty owner precondition exactly once.
Require a nonempty flattened CORSRule list and preserve caller order without inventing a list ceiling.
Preserve ID absence independently from a present empty or escaped string.
Encode every flattened AllowedHeader in caller order within shared XML limits.
Require at least one flattened AllowedMethod and preserve each exact string value.
Require at least one flattened AllowedOrigin and preserve each exact string value.
Encode every flattened ExposeHeader in caller order within shared XML limits.
Preserve optional validated signed-decimal text without imposing a machine-integer ceiling.
